en.headline: Cultural Centre piazza to show Mid-Autumn lights from Thursday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department will light a free Mid-Autumn installation at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre from 17 September to 11 October.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department's Community Programmes Office will present a Mid-Autumn lighting installation at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza in Tsim Sha Tsui from Thursday, 17 September, to Sunday, 11 October.

The office said the lights will be switched on from 6.30pm to 11pm each day, and until midnight on Mid-Autumn night, 25 September. Admission is free. The display sits alongside the department's Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park, which runs from 17 to 27 September.

An inclusive performance titled We Dance, We Care is scheduled at the Cultural Centre Foyer on 27 September. Visitors are told not to bring naked-flame lanterns, alcoholic drinks, aerosol spray, metallic balloons or glass bottles into the venues. The programme is listed as part of the Chinese Culture Festival.

zh.headline: 文化中心露天廣場中秋光影裝置周四起亮燈
zh.dek: 康文署社區節目辦事處將於9月17日至10月11日在香港文化中心露天廣場展出中秋光影裝置，免費入場。
body: 康樂及文化事務署社區節目辦事處將由星期四（9月17日）至10月11日，在尖沙咎香港文化中心露天廣場展出中秋光影裝置。
辦事處表示，裝置每日晚上6時30分至11時亮燈，中秋節正日（9月25日）延長至午夜12時，免費入場。同一時期，康文署亦於9月17日至27日在維多利亞公園舉行中秋綵燈會。
香港文化中心大堂將於9月27日舉行《關愛舞動迎國慶》共融演出。參觀人士不得攜帶明火燈籠、酒精類飲品、罐裝噴劑、金屬氣球或玻璃瓶進場。節目列為中華文化節活動之一。
